big_case.notes: Low national and doctrinal stakes: an individual state attempted-murder prosecution presenting a fact-bound application of settled Double Jeopardy acquittal-characterization precedent (United States v. Scott; Evans v. Michigan) to an idiosyncratic mid-trial Compulsory Process dismissal after two denied directed-verdict motions. Despite a 5-4 intermediate appellate split below, the petition drew zero amicus briefs, an immediate respondent waiver from Mississippi, no call for a response, and a bare single-conference denial.
